claim_boundary.scope: exact-SHA arithmetic reconstruction and dual no-go release only

P2.finding: The r2 receipt records the release-validator SHA, but the release contract cannot self-pin that validator and no separate pre-run launch manifest pins both release and release-validator bytes.
P2.impact: This does not reopen the previous content-chain P1 because the independent additive receipt pins both, but producer-only provenance still has an asymmetric trust root.
P2.minimal_fix: Add a tiny launch manifest or signed digest that pins both the release contract and release validator before execution.

P2.finding: The producer release, release validator and receipt are mode 0664 and there is no producer-side output manifest, detached receipt digest or read-only completion directory.
P2.impact: Byte changes are detectable by this independent receipt, but the producer package is not physically immutable by itself.
P2.minimal_fix: Copy the three producer release artifacts and all pinned entries into an additive release directory, emit output_manifest.sha256 and RUN_COMPLETE, then seal it 0444/0555.

P2.finding: The producer release validator performs strong exact-SHA and semantic recomputation but does not emit its own coordinated tamper ledger; the eight attacks are supplied by this independent review.
P2.impact: No correctness gap in the frozen bytes, but release regression CI does not automatically prove the same mutation resistance.
P2.minimal_fix: Promote the coordinated temp-clone attacks into producer regression tests without weakening the independent audit.
